note: Literals AXLocalePolicy matches with that are in no file of the app bundle. Roughly half are lowercase fragments for containment matching and were never whole labels; the rest are labels Logic composes at runtime, labels from a framework outside this corpus, or labels somebody typed. This set may not GAIN a member -- see Scripts/check-policy-literals-against-canon.py. Two members of the first seeding are known-wrong rather than merely unfound: Project or Section... carries three ASCII full stops where Logic ships U+2026, and Auto Punch / Auto-Punch are two spellings of Logic Autopunch. They are kept here rather than corrected by guess, because guessing a label is what produced #883.
